matched_outlets.match_method: Exact name-and-address branch match to Singapore public listing; official Singapore brand menu matched at brand level, not a branch-specific menu page.
matched_outlets.caveat: The first-party menu is not outlet-specific. Current SFA licence listing establishes a licensed food outlet record but does not independently prove every listed item is sold at this branch today.
